address: B1, The Landis, 41, Section 2, Minquan East Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, 104, Taiwan
bio: The Ten scenes of West Lake – iconic spots in Hangzhou – are the inspiration behind this hotel restaurant's modern decor. The head chef reimagines traditional Hangzhou recipes with new ideas. Try his fairy duck soup or Dongpo pork with a trio of sides. Eating here is a multifaceted experience, with tea sommeliers who are well-versed in tea pairings and, at dinnertime, calligraphers who turn your order into artwork for you to take home.
